import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    f = sys.stdin.buffer
    f.readline()
    for line in f.read().split(b'\n'):
        if not line: continue
        p = line.split(b',')
        d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    out = [b'%s,%.2f' % (k, v) for k, v in sorted(d.items())]
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(o.decode() for o in out) + '\n')
main()
